content.short: Goldfinch enables lending USDC to real-world businesses for real yield.
content.description: Goldfinch enables lenders to deploy USDC to businesses worldwide, unlocking access to capital for real-world borrowers and expanding the range of yield opportunities beyond crypto markets. By linking investors with carefully underwritten private credit deals backed by real-world assets, the platform targets sustainable, risk-adjusted returns that have historically been difficult to attain. The approach seeks to deliver yields largely uncorrelated with crypto market volatility, offering diversification and transparency through an open, user-friendly lending experience.
